description: Chief Minister Bhupendra Patel, all cabinet ministers and all senior bureaucrats of the state government participated in the Chintan Shibir.
body_lead: The Gujarat government is all set to leverage Artificial Intelligence (AI) for more effective governance, senior minister Rushikesh Patel said at Ekta Nagar in Narmada district Sunday. “When the state government has always been eager and leading in adopting new technology, AI will become part of Gujarat’s administration to make its activities effective,” Patel, who is also the state government spokesperson, stated. Patel said this while informing about the conclusion of the three-day Chintan Shibir of the state government that was held in Ekta Nagar.
